scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme For Purchase Of Taxi / Goods Vehicle / Passenger Autorickshaw
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a State Religious Minority Community
Applicant must be a permanent resident of the State
No member of the applicant's family should be an employee of State/Central/Government Public Sector Units
Applicant must possess a relevant driving licence issued by the Regional Transport Authority
Applicant or family members must not have availed any vehicle loan under any State Government scheme
Applicant must not be a loan defaulter in KMDC
The vehicle purchased under this scheme should not be sold to others during the tenure of the loan
If any insurance payment is claimed, the insurance payment details should be shared with the corporation
benefits_summary: Subsidy of up to 33% of the vehicle value, capped at Rs 2.5 lakh per beneficiary.
documents_required: Photo of the beneficiary with the subsidized vehicle
